info.title: Brazilayer — Brazilian Company Data (CNPJ)
info.description:
Official registration data for all Brazilian companies, from the Receita Federal
(Brazilian IRS) public CNPJ registry, updated monthly. Paid endpoints use the x402
payment protocol (USDC on Base): calling without payment returns HTTP 402 with a
`payment-required` header describing price and pay-to address; pay and retry.
Response keys are in Portuguese, mirroring official Brazilian legal terms.
Free sample at GET /v1/cnpj/amostra. Terms: /termos (Portuguese).

get.summary: Open government tenders, live from PNCP ($0.01 via x402)

200.description: Open tenders with deadlines and bidding links. Always 200 when the request is valid: if PNCP is slow or down, the last cached copy is served instead of an error. `fonte` always states what you got: `consultado_em` (when the data was collected from PNCP), `defasagem_segundos` (how old it is), `atualiza_a_cada_minutos` (fixed refresh cadence, 30) and `status` (`ok`, `cache_servido`, `fonte_indisponivel`). Expect staleness of minutes, never an error — PNCP itself takes 15-22s per query.

PagamentoExigido.description:
x402 payment required. The `payment-required` response header carries base64
JSON with accepted payment options (scheme "exact", USDC on Base, amount in
6-decimal units, payTo address). Sign an EIP-3009 authorization and retry with
the `payment-signature` header. x402 client libraries automate this.

If you are not using an x402 client, read the JSON body instead: it states the
price and links the free sample of this dataset plus the free tools.
